features: Supports TRASSIR, ActiveCam, HiWatch, Hikvision, Wisenet and Dahua IP cameras
Up to 8 MP per channel (depending on camera model); hardware acceleration must be enabled in TRASSIR to display 8 MP video
Up to 2 monitors can be connected
Remote access via TRASSIR Client, Android/iOS app and TRASSIR Cloud; SSL encryption
notes: Specifications are from the shared MiniNVR datasheet (E13m1); no product page for this model is published on trassir.com.
Weight is the datasheet net weight; gross weight is 6.2 kg.
